MOBILE STARTING BOARD - RE-READ LIVE 2026-09-14 AND THE RECORDED FRAME-DEFECT IS SUPERSEDED. It is no longer the 347x274 frame whose whole-frame 0.36373 scale put its type at 5.82px on an 8.0px line; the 09-10 pass rebuilt it as 375 x 290 with grid Frame 1000004099 9690:9545 343 x 215 at (16,12), tiles 40.15647 x 40.01694 on a 43.2633 column pitch and a 43.5122 row pitch, numerals in a 13-tall box, and prompt bar Group 307 9690:10317 343 x 20 at (16,258) with its copy 94x8 centred at x=124.5. The tile is the 954 tile times 0.48212 exactly (40.15647/83.29015 = 0.48212 and 13.50/28 = 0.48212), so this is a designed step and not a scaling accident - which is precisely what the old verdict said it was not. Its three siblings 9690-9912, 9690-10413 and 9690-10777 were read the same way and agree to four decimals, so all four frame-defect rows are re-verdicted partial. PARTIAL and not match because the code does not draw this yet: KENO_TILE's clamp floors (4px radius, 2px border, 14px label) bind long before a 343 container, and a 40px tile is under the 44px touch floor index.css:748 applies below 768, so it needs `no-min-size` or a ruling.
